name: web-search
title: Web search
scope: Use this card to write a query with an entity and a constraint, prefer a primary source, read past the title, and cite the URL.
method: Write the query with the entity and the constraint.
Prefer a primary source over a retelling.
Read past the title before using a page.
Separate a snippet from a checked fact.
Cite the URL of the page that supports the claim.
Drop a page that does not actually support the claim.

formulas.name: entity and constraint
formulas.use: Name the thing and the limit in the query so results stay on the question.

formulas.name: primary source
formulas.use: Prefer the document, dataset, or official page that the claim comes from.

formulas.name: checked citation
formulas.use: Attach the URL you read, and do not treat a title or snippet as the fact.

formulas.name: snippet is not the fact
formulas.use: A search hit is a pointer until the page itself supports the claim.

checks: The query names the entity and the constraint.
A primary source was preferred when one exists.
The page was read past the title.
The snippet and the checked fact are separate, and the URL is cited.
limits: A playbook is not a live search result.
Do not answer a current-events question from this card.
A title or snippet is not a checked fact.
